answer: Proof of Stake integrates an economic lotus of capital to prevent Sybil proliferation, ensuring voting power scales with financial commitment rather than identity count. An attacker attempting to subvert the consensus must burn an ember of their own wealth to validate blocks, a process that makes malicious identity creation prohibitively expensive. The network uses this financial weight to whisper truth across nodes, forcing adversaries to bear the full cost of capital depreciation rather than just the negligible cost of creating digital pseudonyms.
